excerpts.quote: To evaluate long-term performance, Lumentum conducted an extensive accelerated life-test program using production UHP devices manufactured on standard production lines and subjected to elevated stress
excerpts.notes: Lumentum reports an accelerated life-test program for its ultra-high-power laser platform used in ELSFP solutions for co-packaged optics. The company states more than 100 million accelerated device hours with zero observed failures and stable operating characteristics, supporting reliability objectives for large-scale AI and CPO deployments.
